tiles.coveragePolicy: native resolution in the complete grid tiles intersecting these named regions; outside these tiles is not distributed

overview.method: one actual source center cell per display block; nearest-neighbour visualization only; native-grid point queries remain separate
overview.sstPolicy: only mask=1 and sea_ice_fraction=0; no interpolation, no categorical-mask averaging by this pipeline

qualityPolicies.mask: Source mask has time: mean. Values outside 1/2/9 and mask=2 with valid SST are treated as ambiguous, not reinterpreted as valid daily bit flags.
qualityPolicies.seaIce: SST under ice is an upstream estimated freezing-point field, not a direct under-ice observation. Default SST queries exclude ice-affected or ambiguous cells.
qualityPolicies.uncertainty: Source analysis_error_sst is preserved in K with time: mean. It is not recomputed as the standard error of an interval mean.
qualityPolicies.temporal: Use CF time and time_bnds, retain conflicting global daily attributes; no claim of a complete calendar-month observation average.
qualityPolicies.species: SST alone does not establish animal presence, density, habitat suitability or collision risk.
